title: Auto insurance quote wizard, step 2 of 4: vehicle details — Shieldline
notes: v1 is a Bootstrap 4 wizard page whose step indicator lives inside an <sl-progress-tracker> declarative shadow root. v2 is an Angular 17 + Angular Material (MDC) rewrite: the step indicator moves out of the shadow root into a light-DOM mat-step-header list (step renamed 'Your vehicle'), while the VIN lookup moves into an <sl-vin-lookup> shadow root. Native selects become <mat-select role=combobox> (Make now first), ownership radios become mat-radio-buttons (reordered, relabelled 'Financed (car loan)'), 'Next' becomes 'Continue' and the 'Back' link becomes a mat-stroked-button. _ngcontent/ng-tns-* attributes and classes everywhere. Decoys: a compact mobile stepper repeating the step list, a sticky mobile action bar with a second 'Back' / 'Continue' pair, and Model/Year/Trim mat-selects next to Make.
